separation: V1 artifacts and outcomes are immutable, are not pooled, and do not select or replace V2 cells.

pretest.order: Stop at the first model with 8/8 valid and correct cells; attempt the second model only if the first fails.
pretest.content: Numerical resource-rule comprehension only; no announcement, partner history, harvest choice, or treatment language.

tokenPreflight.outcomeUse: Calibration calls generate one token from strategic prompts. Retain raw content, exclude every calibration call from the causal panel, and use only provider prompt_eval_count for padding selection; generated content must never be inspected for model, padding, gate, or outcome selection.
tokenPreflight.paddingCandidates: For each factorial arm, choose the smallest n in [0,32] for neutralFormatPadding=' pad' repeated n times.
tokenPreflight.target: The unpadded maximum count in a representative quartet.
tokenPreflight.verification: All four arms must have exactly equal native prompt counts within every one of the 16 quartets.
tokenPreflight.causalLimit: Arm-specific padding is model-visible and confounded with the announcement/history package even when token counts match.

panel.analysisSet: Only quartets with all four schema-valid harvest responses; world effects average their complete role quartets.

hypotheses.announcement: The world-mean paired difference between the entire frozen announcement prompt package and the entire frozen neutral prompt package, averaged over visibility packages, is nonzero.
hypotheses.interaction: The world-mean difference-in-differences among the four entire frozen prompt packages is nonzero.
hypotheses.direction: Both hypotheses are two-sided; signs are not prespecified.
hypotheses.interpretation: The proposed design cannot identify an announcement-semantic effect separately from arm-specific formatting padding.

analysis.tests: Exact enumeration of all two-sided sign flips over complete-world effects, conditional on the frozen panel.
analysis.assumption: The randomization interpretation relies on symmetry/exchangeability of world effects; with eight fixed worlds the tests are exploratory.
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across the announcement and interaction co-primary tests at family-wise alpha 0.05.
analysis.visibility: Report as a secondary descriptive paired estimand.
analysis.labels: Harvest requests are never labelled cooperation or defection.

authorization.current: Only the comprehension-only pretest ladder and offline replay are authorized by this freeze.
authorization.blocked: Token calibration, strategic-prompt calls, collection-manifest creation, and the 64-cell panel require a later clean pre-outcome freeze.
